title: bp Energy Outlook 2025 edition (outlook to 2050)
scenario_note: Two scenarios. None named central. Current Trajectory 'is designed to capture the broad pathway along which the global energy system is travelling'.

entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.metric: electric passenger cars and trucks on the road
entries.quote: In Current Trajectory, the number of electric passenger cars and trucks increases from around 40 million in 2023 to 480 million in 2035 and 1.4 billion in 2050. The corresponding numbers for Below 2° are 560 million and 2.1 billion.
